high_level_description: This image is a close-up selfie featuring three women. The central figure appears to be the bride, as she is wearing a white strapless wedding dress and holding a bouquet of flowers. The bouquet consists of various types of flowers, including roses and lisianthus, in shades of white, light pink, and purple. The bride is also wearing a pearl necklace. To her left is another woman dressed in a green patterned dress with a V-neckline. She has blonde hair styled neatly and is smiling warmly at the camera. To the right of the bride is a third woman with shoulder-length brown hair, also smiling.
